svg.title: Gamma improves a local stock-shock approximation
svg.desc: Calculated changes in the value of a European Call starting at S=K=100, r=b=0.05, sigma=0.2, T=1 year, with only spot changed. The exact value change and first- and second-order Taylor approximations are plotted for shocks from -20 to +20 currency units. The approximation error increases for larger shocks.
svg.text: Gamma improves a local stock-shock approximation
Hypothetical Call · S = K = 100 · r = b = 5% · volatility = 20% · T = 1 year
At ΔS = +5: exact +3.4073 · Delta only +3.1842 · Delta + Gamma +3.4187
Volatility and time are held fixed. Taylor terms are local approximations.
